known_limitations: This manifest records immutable raw source files only; processing and split audits are pending.
The random split is an upstream reference and is not a frozen benchmark split.
Raw ingest does not establish fitness direction, missing-value rules, stable candidate identity, duplicate handling, wild-type identity, homology, or hidden-label authorization.
The mutation-count, fitness-range, and wild-type transfer artifacts are preserved as upstream split references; their membership and leakage controls require separate Split Manifests.
The Hydro task README declares CC-BY-4.0 and first-hand lab provenance; external releases must preserve the FLIP2 DOI and attribution to Escobedo et al. and Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11175470.
